messages:
Rina: Quick sync  we need final SEO handoff for the webinar landing tomorrow. Focus: primary KWs for hero, FAQ longtails, JSON-LD, an internal-link anchor matrix, and immediate 301s for old promo pages. Who can own what?
Owen: I can do keywords + hero copy. Draft primaries: 'production LLM serving', 'low-latency LLM inference'. Supporting: 'inference batching strategies', 'reducing LLM cost', 'KV cache for LLMs'.
Leah: I'll take redirects + canonical headers. Which legacy routes are we consolidating?
Rina: Two to retire: /promo/llm-edge-2025 and /events/edge-demo-2025 -> should go to /webinars/serving-llms-2026. No JS redirects.
Owen: nginx snippet to paste in infra PR:
```
# redirect legacy promos to canonical webinar landing
location = /promo/llm-edge-2025 {
  return 301 /webinars/serving-llms-2026;
}
location = /events/edge-demo-2025 {
  return 301 /webinars/serving-llms-2026;
}
```
Leah: Canonical rule: webinar landing -> self canonical tag + header. Legacy pages -> 301. If any archived page must be kept, mark with meta robots noindex only after confirm.
sam_sales: For lead routing UTMs: use utm_source=redwood, utm_medium=email|social|partner, utm_campaign=serving_llms_jun2026. Sales will map utm_campaign -> CRM field 'campaign_id' and set owner rule to SDR-Webinars.
crawler-bot: scan-report: found 9 pages missing Event or FAQ schema. Suggest adding Event JSON-LD on the landing and FAQ schema for Qs block. Also found 2 pages with duplicate titles.
Owen: JSON-LD Event example (paste exact string into CMS head):
```
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Webinar: Serving LLMs in Production","startDate":"2026-06-26T18:00:00Z","eventStatus":"https://schema.org/EventScheduled","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinars/serving-llms-2026"},"organizer":{"@type":"Organization","name":"Redwood Inference"}}
```
Rina: Internal linking matrix (preferred flow): product overview -> benchmarks -> webinar landing -> integration docs. Anchor suggestions: product overview -> 'why low-latency matters', benchmarks -> 'throughput & latency benchmarks', webinar -> 'register for the webinar', docs -> 'integration guide'. Keep anchors natural, avoid exact-match stuffing.
Leah: Action list: Owen upload hero copy + KW list to CMS; Leah open infra PR with redirects + canonical headers; sam_sales share UTM table and CRM mapping; Rina confirm OG image and publish time. Can folks update status here when done? :thumbsup: 
Owen: Uploaded hero copy and KWs to CMS. Added FAQ longtail Qs.
Leah: Infra PR opened -> tags infra-oncall, includes nginx redirects.
sam_sales: UTM doc shared in #marketing and CRM mapping set.
Rina: I'll review assets and publish schedule. Please post deploy confirmation in this thread after infra deploy. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
